observations: Photo 0: an adult mountain bike standing on a concrete yard, shot from the rear left at an angle, low resolution.
Photo 0: dark grey frame with lime green and yellow graphics; the frame lettering is not legible, so no brand or model can be read.
Photo 0: a lime green front suspension fork; the rear is a rigid frame with no rear shock (a hardtail).
Photo 0: disc brake rotors and calipers on both wheels, a rear derailleur with a multi sprocket cassette and a front derailleur with more than one chainring; the exact gear count cannot be counted.
Photo 0: large wheels with knobbly tyres that look inflated, a black saddle, a bottle cage and flat handlebar with shifters.
Photo 0: no visible rust or bends at this size; a dealer watermark sits on the photo.

identity.kind: adult hardtail mountain bike with front suspension and disc brakes
read_from: photo 0 frame, fork, brakes and drivetrain

claims.evidence: No brand or model is readable in photo 0 to place its quality tier; the parts seen (disc brakes, suspension fork, derailleurs) fit a mid range bike but the component grade is not visible.
Photo 0 shows front and rear derailleurs but the chainrings and cassette sprockets cannot be counted at this resolution.
Photo 0 shows a front suspension fork; note the rear is rigid, so there is front suspension only, not full suspension.

risks.risk: Unknown brand and low grade components; a no name bike is worth much less than a known brand.
risks.proof: Close photos of the down tube brand name, the derailleur and shifter labels, and the frame serial under the bottom bracket.

risks.risk: Gears do not shift cleanly, chain or cassette worn, or brakes not working.
risks.proof: A clip of the bike ridden through all the gears and braking hard with both brakes.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a drivetrain and brake service

risks.proof: A clip pushing down on the handlebar to compress the fork, plus a close photo of the fork stanchions.

risks.risk: Cracked or bent frame or buckled wheels not visible from one angle.
risks.proof: Photos of both sides of the frame, the joints at the head tube and bottom bracket, and each wheel spinning.
risks.if_unproven: as needing wheel truing and frame inspection

risks.proof: Photo of the frame serial number under the bottom bracket and a purchase receipt.
risks.if_unproven: as a bike without proof of ownership, held until the serial is shown

proof_requests: Close photo of the brand on the down tube and the frame serial under the bottom bracket.
Clip riding through all gears and braking with both brakes.
Close photos of the shifters, derailleurs and cassette.
Photos of the other side of the bike and both wheels spinning.
response.reason: Photo 0 clearly shows an adult hardtail mountain bike with front suspension and disc brakes, so it can be priced by type at its worst case as an unbranded bike needing service until the brand, serial and a riding clip are shown.
